answer: Each submission hangs on the wander of a task receipt, and the lotus is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, unlocked only after continuous uptime, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ripple of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
